english.title: Cause use of motor vehicle - adjusting device not working - seat belt

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 48(4)(b) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
cause use of a motor vehicle on a road fitted with a seat belt
when the adjusting device/device and retracting mechanism
was/were not maintained so that the belt could be readily adjusted
in accordance with the design

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

6 months
